question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Renewel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Renewel"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Renewal"**.
 
• **Renewal** means the process of making something new again or reviving it. (नवीकरण)
 
 
• **Example: **The renewal of his contract brought relief to his team.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Horizon** (क्षितिज): The line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

 
 
• **Example:** The sun dipped below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of orange and pink.
 
 
 
• **Composer** (संगीतकार): A person who writes music.
 
 
• **Example:** Beethoven is considered one of the greatest composers of classical music.
 
 
 
• **Algebra** (बीजगणित): A branch of mathematics dealing with symbols and the rules for manipulating those symbols.
 
 
• **Example:** Solving algebraic equations is an essential skill for students in mathematics.
